shell.description: The shell interpreter used to execute bound commands.

chord_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for chord chains. 0 means no timeout.

abort_key.description: Keysym name used to abort chord chains.

mapping_notify.description: Count of mapping notify events to handle (e.g., -1 for all).

redirect.description: Path to a file to redirect command output to.

status_fifo.description: Path to a FIFO file for status information.

bindings.description: List of binding definitions containing hotkeys and commands.
